name: The Drowned Bell-Ringer
kind: Hushed Far Side hero, B-grade boss

lighting.toll: Cold white daylight from upper-left broken cathedral window, restrained white edge light

locks: 6m drowned grey-stone giant; long arms, huge five-digit hands and bare stone feet.
Head is a cracked bronze cathedral bell, green with age; dark hollow mouth; no human face or eyes.
Hush crack on anatomical LEFT bell side, leaking violet ash. This side was chosen in the front for continuity; source design leaves side open.
Rotting dark-blue sleeveless wrapped robe, short rusted collar chain, diagonal torso chain from right shoulder to left waist, chain belt.
One tree-trunk-sized bell-clapper hammer in anatomical RIGHT hand: long bronze shaft and elongated rounded teardrop striking weight, no crossbar.

ability.toll: One force annulus bursts out a step beyond arm reach; within arm's length the pressure passes over the safe inner pocket.
ability.toll_witness: One incidental generic adult 178cm person, hands over ears, inside safe zone. Approximate projected ratio about 0.31 in kept scene.
